name: app-shell
title: App shell
description: The frame of every signed-in screen: a collapsible sidebar that becomes a drawer below 768 px, a sticky topbar and the page's main region, capped at content-max.

meta.useWhen: Any signed-in screen that shares navigation. Every other layout except auth sits inside it.
meta.avoidWhen: Signed-out screens such as sign in or reset password: use auth.

regions.sidebar: SidebarHeader (brand, SidebarTrigger), SidebarContent with groups of SidebarItems, SidebarFooter (user-menu)
regions.topbar: breadcrumb-bar, search, notification-list in a popover, user-menu; after the menu button below 768 px
regions.default: The page: one page-header and its sections, or another layout such as list-filters or dashboard
